verdict.rationale: Rippling documents device lifecycle management, enrollment/zero-touch deployment, and identity-tied policy enforcement across macOS/Windows/iOS/iPadOS (rippling-it-docs-5,6,7,10,19), and shows access auto-updates when roles change or employees leave (rippling-it-docs-18). However, there is no explicit documentation of remote lock/wipe capability tied to identity, which is a core part of the story. missing for 10: explicit remote lock/wipe feature documentation, independent/hands-on corroboration of lock/wipe or full MDM lifecycle claims.
